title: Chrome security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-027.072717: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Chrome Security Updates
leadParagraph: Google has released Chrome version 60.0.3112.78 for Windows, Mac, and Linux. This version addresses multiple vulnerabilities that, if exploited, may allow an attacker to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Google has released Chrome version 60.0.3112.78 for Windows, Mac, and Linux. This version addresses multiple vulnerabilities that, if exploited, may allow an attacker to take control of an affected system.

Further information on these vulnerabilities can be seen on the Google Chrome Website at https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2017/07/stable-channel-update-for-desktop.html
